verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs let users pick where data lives. A fully independent EU instance is hosted in Frankfurt (DigitalOcean FRA1, eu.glitchtip.com) for data residency needs, hosted servers run in US and EU regions, and the open-source product can be self-hosted on your own server for full control. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the regional hosting, and detailed documentation of the US region's location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
